simulator.title: One governance action. Five frameworks closed.
simulator.lead: Stop governing regulation by regulation. Every action you take in Niticore is mapped and credited against each obligation it satisfies.

explorer.title: Five frameworks, mapped clause by clause.
explorer.lead: The global standards your auditors ask about, built into the platform as working controls, not PDFs.

frameworks.name: EU AI Act
frameworks.status: The global benchmark. High-risk enforcement active as of August 2026.

capabilities.title: Annex III risk classifier
capabilities.body: Determines whether a system falls under critical infrastructure, education, employment, essential services, law enforcement or biometric categorisation.

capabilities.title: Conformity & technical files
capabilities.body: Guides internal and third-party conformity evaluation, and auto-generates Annex IV technical files.

capabilities.title: FRIA
capabilities.body: Built-in Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment templates for Article 27 obligations.

capabilities.title: GPAI & foundation models
capabilities.body: Tracking for general-purpose AI models and systemic risk mitigation.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 42001
frameworks.status: The premier international certifiable standard for AI organisational governance.

capabilities.title: Clauses 4 to 10
capabilities.body: Direct clause-by-clause mapping: context, leadership, planning, support, operations and evaluation.

capabilities.title: Annex A & B controls
capabilities.body: Control libraries embedded natively into approval workflows.

capabilities.title: Certification readiness
capabilities.body: Internal audit dry-runs and certification readiness benchmarking.

frameworks.name: NIST AI RMF
frameworks.status: The standard of choice for US enterprise, federal agencies and global technology providers.

capabilities.title: Core functions
capabilities.body: Work organised by GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE.

capabilities.title: Transatlantic cross-mapping
capabilities.body: Dynamic mapping between NIST sub-categories and EU AI Act articles.

frameworks.name: GDPR & UK GDPR
frameworks.status: Privacy obligations wired into every AI system that touches personal data.

capabilities.title: Article 22 controls
capabilities.body: Direct controls for automated individual decision-making, including profiling.

capabilities.title: Data lineage
capabilities.body: Lineage, minimisation and privacy-preserving model verification.

frameworks.name: DIFC Regulation 10
frameworks.status: In active enforcement since January 2026. Niticore treats DIFC as a first-class jurisdiction, not an afterthought.

capabilities.title: Governance framework builder
capabilities.body: Build the board-approved AI governance framework the regulation requires.

capabilities.title: DIFC AI Impact Assessment
capabilities.body: Automated impact assessments, unified with EU AI Act FRIA and GDPR DPIA in one artifact.

capabilities.title: AI Systems Officer
capabilities.body: A dedicated ASO role with its own audit dashboard.

pipeline.title: From statute to evidence, in five links.
pipeline.lead: Abstract legal text becomes day-to-day engineering and compliance work, and every link stays connected.
points: Prevents compliance amnesia, where policies live in disconnected PDFs.
Links every line of production code and model prompt to the exact legal requirement it fulfils.

regional.title: The UAE, treated as three jurisdictions.
regional.lead: Most US and European platforms treat Middle Eastern compliance as an afterthought. Niticore treats mainland UAE, DIFC and ADGM as distinct, first-class legal jurisdictions.

jurisdictions.name: Dubai International Financial Centre
capabilities: Dedicated AI Systems Officer role and audit dashboard

Local data residency and sovereign AI infrastructure compliance

jurisdictions.name: Abu Dhabi Global Market

cta.title: Map every obligation in one pass.
cta.lead: See how far your current controls already reach across EU, ISO, NIST, GDPR and UAE requirements, and exactly where the gaps are.
